people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
translations.bsb: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
translations.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
translations.asv: and he took food and was strengthened. And he was certain days with the disciples that were at Damascus.
